name: Crossings At Corona
summary: Crossings at Corona is a vibrant community retail hub in Corona, California, featuring popular chain stores, diverse dining options, and a multi-screen cinema. This open-air shopping center serves as a convenient one-stop destination for Inland Empire families seeking quality shopping, entertainment, and dining experiences.
demographics: Crossings at Corona attracts a diverse, family-oriented demographic primarily from the Corona and Riverside County area, with a strong representation of middle to upper-middle income households. The trade area serves young families and professionals aged 25-54 who value convenience and variety in their shopping experience. Visitors typically seek one-stop shopping combining everyday necessities with dining and entertainment options, reflecting the suburban lifestyle preferences of the Inland Empire region. The center draws from a growing residential population with household incomes ranging from $60,000 to $120,000 annually, appealing to value-conscious shoppers who appreciate quality national retailers.
description: Crossings at Corona stands as a premier community retail destination in the heart of Corona, California, offering residents and visitors a comprehensive shopping, dining, and entertainment experience. Located at 2470 Tuscany Street, this open-air shopping center has established itself as a cornerstone of the local community, bringing together popular chain stores, diverse restaurant options, and a multi-screen cinema under one convenient location. The center's thoughtful layout and tenant mix cater to the everyday needs of Inland Empire families, from grocery shopping and retail therapy to casual dining and catching the latest blockbuster films. With its strategic position in one of Southern California's fastest-growing communities, Crossings at Corona has become a go-to gathering place where convenience meets quality. The shopping center maintains strong community connections through regular events and announcements, fostering a welcoming atmosphere that keeps visitors returning time and again. Its impressive 4.5-star rating from nearly 4,000 reviews speaks to the consistently positive experience shoppers enjoy at this well-maintained and accessible retail hub.
